items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How about Dude Brown? When did you first run into Dude Brown... [INTERVIEWEE] He was playing good.

ctx.x: Yeah, he came here. He went to school here. He went to Howard. His stepfather was Chiropodous(?). They moved here. Frank Wess came here from Oklahoma, and he came here and he was... He played around here. Then he first got a good start playing with the band I was with, Coleridge Davis. They'd go up Atlantic City, up to Club Harlem.
